summary: Peraso Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase the maximum shares eligible for sale under an existing at-the-market offering agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann. The filing updates the prior prospectus to reflect a new $670,000 offering limit, with $9.37M already sold. The public float was $27.5M, and the stock closed at $0.9793 on May 13, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. No deal terms.
